name: Customer
description: Central data model for customer records containing personal details, company affiliation, contact methods, and status tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name of the customer

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for contact

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary phone number

fields.name: company
fields.description: Company or organization name

fields.name: status
fields.description: Customer status (e.g., active, inactive, prospect, lead)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when customer record was created

email.message: Must be a valid email address

status.message: Status must be one of the predefined values

name: DealStage
description: Configuration model for sales pipeline stages with ordering, probability percentages, and stage-specific requirements

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the deal stage

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the stage (e.g., Prospecting, Qualification, Proposal)

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sequence order of the stage in the pipeline (lower numbers appear first)

fields.name: probability
fields.description: Win probability percentage for deals in this stage (0-100)

fields.name: pipelineType
fields.description: Type of pipeline this stage belongs to (e.g., Sales, Renewal, Upsell)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this stage is currently active and available for use

fields.name: isFinalStage
fields.description: Indicates if this is a terminal stage (Won or Lost)

name: User
description: Store user accounts for sales team members, account managers, and administrators with role-based access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name for display purposes

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role for access control (admin, account_manager, sales_rep)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.email: Must be a valid email format
constraints.role: Must be one of: admin, account_manager, sales_rep

name: Interaction
description: Records all customer interactions and communication history including calls, emails, meetings, and notes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the interaction

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer involved in this interaction

fields.name: interactionType
fields.description: Type of interaction (call, email, meeting, note, chat)

fields.name: interactionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the interaction occurred

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who logged or participated in the interaction

fields.name: dealId
fields.description: Reference to associated deal if applicable

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Detailed notes and content of the interaction

fields.name: durationMinutes
fields.description: Duration of the interaction in minutes

relationships.description: Each interaction belongs to one customer
Each interaction is logged by one user
Each interaction may be associated with one deal

indexes.description: Index for quick lookup of all interactions by customer
Index for chronological queries and reporting
Index for filtering interactions by user

interactionType.description: Interaction type must be one of the predefined values

name: Deal
description: Represents sales opportunities with stage progression, estimated value, probability, and expected close dates

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the deal

fields.name: title
fields.description: Name or title of the sales opportunity

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer associated with this deal

fields.name: stageId
fields.description: Current pipeline stage of the deal

fields.name: value
fields.description: Estimated monetary value of the deal

fields.name: probability
fields.description: Win probability percentage (0-100)

fields.name: expectedCloseDate
fields.description: Anticipated date for deal closure

fields.name: ownerId
fields.description: Reference to the user responsible for this deal

relationships.description: Deal is in a specific stage
Deal is owned by a user

name: ActivityLog
description: Comprehensive audit trail tracking all system activities, changes, and user actions for compliance and reporting purposes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the activity log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who performed the action

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (Customer, Deal, Interaction, etc.)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the affected entity

fields.name: action
fields.description: Type of operation performed (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, VIEW)

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before/after values of modified fields

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the activity occurred

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

relationships.description: Links activity log entry to the user who performed the action

indexes.name: idx_user_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimize queries filtering by user and time range

indexes.name: idx_entity
indexes.description: Optimize queries retrieving all activities for a specific entity

action.description: Restrict action types to predefined values

entityType.description: Restrict entity types to existing data models

name: Task
description: Action items and reminders for sales team with assignment, due dates, priority levels, and completion tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief title or summary of the task

fields.name: assignedUserId
fields.description: ID of the user assigned to complete this task

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date and time when the task is due

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the task (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the task (pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled)

fields.name: relatedEntityType
fields.description: Type of entity this task relates to (customer, deal, interaction)

fields.name: relatedEntityId
fields.description: ID of the related customer, deal, or interaction

relationships.description: Task is assigned to a user
Task may be related to a customer
Task may be related to a deal

indexes.description: Quick lookup of tasks by assigned user
Efficient querying of tasks by due date for reminders
Retrieve all tasks related to a specific entity
